THEINSATIABLE-STRIKE_INSATIABLE.title: Strike
THEINSATIABLE-DEFEND_INSATIABLE.title: Defend
THEINSATIABLE-SAND_STONE.title: Sandstone
THEINSATIABLE-SAND_BLOWING.title: Sand Blowing
THEINSATIABLE-SANDWORM_BITE.title: Sandworm Bite
THEINSATIABLE-SANDWORM_BITE.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each [gold]Quicksand[/gold] on the enemy.
THEINSATIABLE-SAND_STORM.title: Sandstorm
THEINSATIABLE-SAND_STORM.description:
Apply {QuickSandPower:diff()} [gold]Quicksand[/gold] to ALL enemies.
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
THEINSATIABLE-APPENDAGE_SLICE.title: Appendage Slice
THEINSATIABLE-QUICKSAND_STRIKE.title: Quicksand Strike
THEINSATIABLE-QUICKSAND_STRIKE.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply {QuickSandPower:diff()} [gold]Quicksand[/gold].
Add a [gold]Sandstone[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-SPINNING_SILK.title: Spinning Silk
THEINSATIABLE-EARTHQUAKE.title: Earthquake
THEINSATIABLE-EARTHQUAKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Apply {QuickSandPower:diff()} [gold]Quicksand[/gold] to ALL enemies.
THEINSATIABLE-SWARM_UP.title: Swarm Up
THEINSATIABLE-SWARM_UP.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies {Repeat:diff()} times.
THEINSATIABLE-LYING_IN_SAND.title: Lying in Sand
THEINSATIABLE-BLIND_BY_SAND.title: Blind by Sand
THEINSATIABLE-TEST_THE_STONES.title: Test the Stones
THEINSATIABLE-TEST_THE_STONES.descriptio:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply [gold]Imbalanced[/gold] for one turn.
THEINSATIABLE-INSATIABLE_THRASH.title: Insatiable Thrash
THEINSATIABLE-INSATIABLE_THRASH.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the enemy has [gold]Quicksand[/gold], attack twice.
THEINSATIABLE-TOXIC_SPIT.title: Toxic Spit
THEINSATIABLE-TOXIC_SPIT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add a [gold]Toxic[/gold] to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-CHOMP.title: Chomp
THEINSATIABLE-CHOMP.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
Add two [gold]Dazed[/gold] to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-INSATIABLE_BODY_SLAM.title: Insatiable Body Slam
THEINSATIABLE-SAND_STONE_STRIKE.title: Sandstone Strike
THEINSATIABLE-SAND_STONE_STRIKE.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add a [gold]Sandstone[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-REPAIR_HIVE.title: Repair Burrow
THEINSATIABLE-REPAIR_HIVE.description: [gold]Transform[/gold] all Status cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] into [gold]Sandstone[/gold]. Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each card [gold]Transformed[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-FLING_SAND.title: Fling Sand
THEINSATIABLE-FLING_SAND.description:
Apply {QuickSandPower:diff()} [gold]Quicksand[/gold].
Put a card from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-FLING_SAND.selectionScreen: Choose a card to add to your Hand.
THEINSATIABLE-QUICK_THORNS.title: Quick Thorns
THEINSATIABLE-AVOID_PREDATORS.title: Avoid Predators
THEINSATIABLE-AVOID_PREDATORS.descriptio:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Immune to the next {AvoidPredatorsPower:diff()} applications of [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], [gold]Weak[/gold], and [gold]Frail[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-SEDIMENTATION.title: Sedimentation
THEINSATIABLE-GOLD_AND_SAND.title: Gold and Sand
THEINSATIABLE-DEATH_HIGHWAY.title: Death Highway
THEINSATIABLE-DEATH_HIGHWAY.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Whenever you apply [gold]Quicksand[/gold], put this card from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] or [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-INSECT_PLAGUE.title: Insect Plague
THEINSATIABLE-INSECT_PLAGUE.description:
If you attacked this enemy this turn, apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
THEINSATIABLE-SAND_WALL.title: Sand Wall
THEINSATIABLE-SAND_WALL.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Apply {QuickSandPower:diff()} [gold]Quicksand[/gold] to ALL enemies.
Add a [gold]Sandstone[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-REINFORCE.title: Reinforce
THEINSATIABLE-REINFORCE.description:
Double your current [gold]Block[/gold] and ALL creatures' [gold]Quicksand[/gold].
Copy ALL [gold]Sandstone[/gold] in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-TENDER_TOXIC.title: Tender Toxic
THEINSATIABLE-TENDER_TOXIC.description: After playing this card, for each card you play this turn, ALL enemies lose {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] and {DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-SWIM_SAND_SEA.title: Swim the Sand Sea
THEINSATIABLE-SWIM_SAND_SEA.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Whenever you apply [gold]Quicksand[/gold], return this card to your [gold]Hand[/gold] from anywhere.
THEINSATIABLE-SHRINKER_LASER.title: Shrinker Laser
THEINSATIABLE-SHRINKER_LASER.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
For {Repeat:diff()} turns, this enemy's attacks deal [blue]{DamageDecrease}%[/blue] less damage.
THEINSATIABLE-DRUG_RESISTANCE.title: Drug Resistance
THEINSATIABLE-DRUG_RESISTANCE.descriptio: You are immune to debuffs you have already received this combat.
THEINSATIABLE-CRYSTAL_CLEAR.title: Crystal Clear
THEINSATIABLE-CRYSTAL_CLEAR.description: Whenever you apply [gold]Quicksand[/gold], deal {CrystalClearPower:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
THEINSATIABLE-SCORCHED_EARTH.title: Scorched Earth
THEINSATIABLE-SCORCHED_EARTH.description:
Apply {QuickSandPower:diff()} [gold]Quicksand[/gold] to ALL enemies.
Each [gold]Quicksand[/gold] also increases damage enemies take from attacks by [blue]4%[/blue].
THEINSATIABLE-MUDDY.title: Muddy
THEINSATIABLE-MUDDY.description:
Apply {QuickSandPower:diff()} [gold]Quicksand[/gold] to ALL enemies.
[gold]Quicksand[/gold] effects on enemies are doubled.
THEINSATIABLE-SANDWORM_SHOCK.title: Sandworm Shock
THEINSATIABLE-SANDWORM_SHOCK.description: Apply {QuickSandPower:diff()} [gold]Quicksand[/gold] and {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies X{IfUpgraded:show:+1} times.
THEINSATIABLE-MOBILE_DUNE.title: Mobile Dune
THEINSATIABLE-MOBILE_DUNE.description: At the start of your turn, equalize all enemies' [gold]Quicksand[/gold], then apply {SandySkyPower:diff()} [gold]Quicksand[/gold] to ALL enemies.
THEINSATIABLE-MAKING_SANDCASTLES.title: Making Sandcastles
THEINSATIABLE-SALIVATE.title: Salivate
THEINSATIABLE-SALIVATE.description: Whenever [gold]Quicksand[/gold] decrease, gain [gold]Vigor[/gold] equal to the amount decreased.
THEINSATIABLE-LUNGING_BITE.title: Lunging Bite
THEINSATIABLE-LUNGING_BITE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Deal double damage to enemies with [gold]Block[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-GOLD_RUSH.title: Gold Rush
THEINSATIABLE-BURROWED.title: Burrowed
THEINSATIABLE-BURROWED.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Apply {QuickSandPower:diff()} [gold]Quicksand[/gold] to ALL enemies.
As long as [gold]Block[/gold] is not broken, [gold]Block[/gold] is not removed at the start of your turn.
THEINSATIABLE-EVAPORATE.title: Evaporate
THEINSATIABLE-EVAPORATE.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Apply {QuickSandPower:diff()} [gold]Quicksand[/gold].
If the enemy's current HP is not greater than its [gold]Quicksand[/gold], [gold]Swallow[/gold] it.
THEINSATIABLE-WEATHERING.title: Weathering
THEINSATIABLE-WEATHERING.description:
At the start of your turn, draw {Cards:diff()} additional cards and apply [red]Affliction[/red] on a card in your hand: [purple]Weathering[/purple].
Your cards are immune to other [red]Afflictions[/red].
THEINSATIABLE-INSATIABLE_SWALLOW.title: Insatiable Swallow
THEINSATIABLE-INSATIABLE_DRAW_PILE.title: Draw Pile
THEINSATIABLE-INSATIABLE_DRAW_PILE.descr: Choose a card from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] to [gold]Swallow[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-INSATIABLE_HAND_PILE.title: Hand
THEINSATIABLE-INSATIABLE_HAND_PILE.descr: Choose a card from your [gold]Hand[/gold] to [gold]Swallow[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-INSATIABLE_DISCARD_PILE.de: Choose a card from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] to [gold]Swallow[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-INSATIABLE_NO_ESCAPE.title: No Escape!
THEINSATIABLE-INSATIABLE_NO_ESCAPE.descr:
Add three [gold]Insatiable Swallow[/gold] to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] and [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
When you take unblocked attack damage, add an [gold]Insatiable Swallow[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
At the end of your turn, if there are no [gold]Insatiable Swallow[/gold] in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], [gold]Hand[/gold], or [gold]Discard Pile[/gold], [gold]Swallow[/gold] ALL enemies.
THEINSATIABLE-HIVE_MIND.title: Hive Mind
THEINSATIABLE-HIVE_MIND.description: When you play a card, play all cards with the same name from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-LURCH_FOR_LUNCH.title: Lurch for Lunch
THEINSATIABLE-LURCH_FOR_LUNCH.descriptio:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Add an [gold]Insatiable Swallow[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-HAVE_DINNER.title: Have Dinner
THEINSATIABLE-HAVE_DINNER.description:
Choose [blue]any[/blue] card to [gold]Swallow[/gold].
If a card was [gold]Swallowed[/gold], draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
THEINSATIABLE-BE_FULL.title: Be Full
THEINSATIABLE-BE_FULL.description:
Choose [blue]any[/blue] card to [gold]Swallow[/gold].
If a card was [gold]Swallowed[/gold], draw {Cards:diff()} cards and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
THEINSATIABLE-LOCUST_OF_CONQUEST.title: Locust of Conquest
THEINSATIABLE-LOCUST_OF_CONQUEST.descrip:
[blue]Corresponds to Power cards[/blue]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies {Repeat:diff()} times.
THEINSATIABLE-LOCUST_OF_FAMINE.title: Locust of Famine
THEINSATIABLE-LOCUST_OF_FAMINE.descripti:
[blue]Corresponds to Skill cards[/blue]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
Apply {QuickSandPower:diff()} [gold]Quicksand[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-LOCUST_OF_PESTILENCE.title: Locust of Pestilence
THEINSATIABLE-LOCUST_OF_PESTILENCE.descr:
[blue]Corresponds to Status cards[/blue]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
Apply {PoisonPower:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-LOCUST_OF_WAR.title: Locust of War
THEINSATIABLE-LOCUST_OF_WAR.description:
[blue]Corresponds to Attack cards[/blue]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-LOCUST_OF_DEATH.title: Locust of Death
THEINSATIABLE-LOCUST_OF_DEATH.descriptio:
[blue]Corresponds to Curse cards[/blue]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-LOCUST_OF_ABYSS.title: Locust of Abyss
THEINSATIABLE-LOCUST_OF_ABYSS.descriptio:
[blue]Corresponds to Quest cards[/blue]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
THEINSATIABLE-ABYSS.title: Abyss
THEINSATIABLE-ABYSS.description:
Choose [blue]any[/blue] six cards to [gold]Swallow[/gold].
Based on the types of cards [gold]Swallowed[/gold], add the corresponding {IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Upgraded[/gold] |}[gold]Locust[/gold] cards to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
[red]If Abyss is Swallowed, instead gain {IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Upgraded[/gold] |}one of each Locust card[/red]
THEINSATIABLE-LIVING_WEAPON.title: Living Weapon
THEINSATIABLE-BEGGAR_CHOICE.title: Beggar's Choice
THEINSATIABLE-SWORD_OF_SAND.title: Sword of Sand
THEINSATIABLE-SWORD_OF_SAND.description:
Deal damage equal to the [gold]Quicksand[/gold] you applied this turn.{InCombat:
(Deals {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)|}
THEINSATIABLE-SHIELD_OF_SAND.title: Shield of Sand
THEINSATIABLE-SHIELD_OF_SAND.description:
Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the [gold]Quicksand[/gold] you applied this turn.{InCombat:
(Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold])|}
THEINSATIABLE-MAW_OF_VOID.title: Maw of Void
THEINSATIABLE-MAW_OF_VOID.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Your next card costs 0{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and is [gold]Swallowed[/gold] after being played.
THEINSATIABLE-FULLY_ABSORB.title: Fully Absorb
THEINSATIABLE-LAW_OF_HIVE.title: Law of the Hive
THEINSATIABLE-LAW_OF_HIVE.description:
[gold]Swallow[/gold] ALL enemies with current HP not greater than {LawOfHive:diff()}.
If [gold]Fatel[/gold], raise your Max HP by {MaxHp:diff()}.
THEINSATIABLE-SWALLOW_STRIKE.title: Swallow Strike
THEINSATIABLE-SWALLOW_STRIKE.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Damage increases by {ExtraDamage:diff()} for each time you [gold]Swallow[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-EAT_LESS_MORE_OFTEN.title: Eat Less, More Often
THEINSATIABLE-EAT_LESS_MORE_OFTEN.descri:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
Costs 1 less {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} for each time you [gold]Swallow[/gold] this turn.
THEINSATIABLE-GRAIN_RESERVES.title: Grain Reserves
THEINSATIABLE-HONEY_XYLITOL.title: Honey Xylitol
THEINSATIABLE-OUROBOROS_FROM.title: Ouroboros Form
THEINSATIABLE-OUROBOROS_FROM.description:
Whenever you [gold]Swallow[/gold], all cards' [gold]Values[/gold] increase by {OuroborosFromPower:diff()}.{IfUpgraded:show:
Choose [blue]any[/blue] card to [gold]Swallow[/gold].}
THEINSATIABLE-SLUMBER.title: Slumber
THEINSATIABLE-RUMINATION.title: Rumination
THEINSATIABLE-RUMINATION.description: Add a copy of the first card you [gold]Swallow[/gold] each turn to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It gains [gold]Self-Swallow[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-NOT_ONLY_ONE_HOLE.title: Not Only One Hole
THEINSATIABLE-NOT_ONLY_ONE_HOLE.descript:
Choose a card from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] or [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] to [gold]Swallow[/gold].
If a card was [gold]Swallowed[/gold], choose two cards from the other [gold]pile[/gold] and put them into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-NOT_ONLY_ONE_HOLE.selectio: Choose two cards to add to your Hand.
THEINSATIABLE-APPENDAGE_SCALPEL.title: Appendage Scalpel
THEINSATIABLE-APPENDAGE_SCALPEL.descript:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage X times.
Deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for every 3 debuffs on the enemy.
THEINSATIABLE-DESERT_MIRAGE.title: "Oasis"
THEINSATIABLE-DESERT_MIRAGE.description:
Heal {Heal:diff()} HP.
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Apply {QuickSandPower:diff()} [gold]Quicksand[/gold] to ALL enemies.
[gold]Quicksand[/gold] do not decrease this turn.
THEINSATIABLE-SAND_FLOWS.title: Sand Flows
THEINSATIABLE-SAND_FLOWS.description:
At the start of your turn, apply {SandySkyPower:diff()} [gold]Quicksand[/gold] to ALL enemies.
At the end of the turn, ALL enemies take damage equal to their [gold]Quicksand[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-DINOSAUR_FOSSIL.title: Dinosaur Fossil
THEINSATIABLE-DINOSAUR_FOSSIL.descriptio:
After combat, randomly receive {DinosaurFossilPower:diff()} of the following rewards:
A rare card/A relic
Two potions/One hundred [gold]Gold[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-GLUTTONY.title: Gluttony
THEINSATIABLE-GLUTTONY.description:
[gold]Exhausting[/gold] cards also counts as [gold]Swallowing[/gold].
Enemy deaths also count as [gold]Swallowing[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-LAY_EGGS.title: Lay Eggs
THEINSATIABLE-LAY_EGGS.description: At the start of your turn, add {LayEggsPower:diff()} [gold]Hatch[/gold] and [gold]Nibble[/gold] to your hand.
THEINSATIABLE-HATCH.title: Hatch
THEINSATIABLE-NIBBLE.title: Nibble
THEINSATIABLE-NIBBLE.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each [gold]Hatch[/gold] in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-RAISING_SAND.title: Raising Sand
THEINSATIABLE-RAISING_SAND.description:
If the enemy has [gold]Quicksand[/gold], draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
THEINSATIABLE-MILLIPEDE_NEVER_DIE.title: Millipede Never Die
THEINSATIABLE-MILLIPEDE_NEVER_DIE.descri:
At the end of the turn, play a copy of the last card you played in the previous {MillipedeNeverDiePower:diff()} turns.
(Does not play Millipede Never Die)
THEINSATIABLE-SAND_BURIAL.title: Sand Burial
THEINSATIABLE-SAND_BURIAL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
This turn, each time another ally damages this enemy, apply {QuickSandPower:diff()} [gold]Quicksand[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-UNDER_SIX_FEET.title: Under Six Feet
THEINSATIABLE-UNDER_SIX_FEET.description: After playing this card, if [gold]Quicksand[/gold] is applied six times to the target enemy in one turn, [gold]Swallow[/gold] it.
THEINSATIABLE-EGG_AGAINST_STONE.title: Egg Against Stone
THEINSATIABLE-EGG_AGAINST_STONE.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold].
The next time you take unblocked attack damage, lose all [gold]Plating[/gold].
THEINSATIABLE-STEAL_TECHNIQUE.title: Steal Technique
THEINSATIABLE-STEAL_TECHNIQUE.descriptio:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Swallow[/gold] a card using [gold]Thievery[/gold] logic. Add a copy to your hand after {CalculationBase:diff()} turns.
